summary: An 8-minute screen-recording tutorial with a small face-cam bubble. It works because every step is zoomed into and called out, so viewers never hunt for the cursor.
hook: Shows the finished result for 3 seconds before any explanation, with a title overlay naming the outcome.

beats.label: Result first
beats.what_happens: Finished result on screen with a title overlay.

beats.label: Setup
beats.what_happens: Opens the app; cursor highlighted, 150% zoom on each menu click.

beats.label: Steps one to three
beats.what_happens: Three numbered steps, each with a callout box and a zoom-in.

beats.label: Steps four and five
beats.what_happens: Two more numbered steps with callouts; typing pauses sped up 2x.

beats.label: Recap and outro
beats.what_happens: Face-cam goes full screen for a recap; end screen with two video cards.

style.pacing: Calm; shots average 6.5 s. Pauses while typing are sped up 2x rather than cut.
style.framing: Full-frame screen recording with a circular face-cam bottom right. Zooms of 150 to 200% on every click target.
style.transitions: Smooth zoom transitions between steps; hard cuts elsewhere.
style.text_and_graphics: Numbered step titles top left, yellow callout boxes around buttons, cursor highlight ring.
style.audio: Clear voiceover, no music under instructions, soft click sound effects.
style.delivery: Calm, measured voice at about 140 words per minute; face-cam shows steady eye contact.
style.look: Dark-mode app UI, neutral face-cam lighting, no color grade.

spoken_lines_internal: Let me show you the end result first.
